value.rationale: The isomorphism type of the 64-dimensional arithmetic Picard torus is an intrinsic invariant of a canonical exceptional-characteristic boundary, not determined by its previously known rational H1 spectrum or zeta function. It distinguishes induced two-dimensional tori from the rationally isogenous sum of split and anisotropic tori, while the 45 additive local gluing directions determine exact finite Picard groups.
